fullContentHtml:
Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : University of Kota (UOK) has released the Admit Card for the Rajasthan State Eligibility Test (SET) Exam 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 14 June 2026 to 10 August 2026 (Extended). The Examination is going to conducted on 13 September 2026. Candidates must download their Rajasthan State Eligibility Test SET Admit Card 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 June 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, SBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) of Rajasthan State and Out of State : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS, SBC, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) of Rajasthan State Candidates : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST of Rajasthan State and All PwD Candidates : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
